notes.title: Early Access 0.35 : Reworked demos and many bug fixes

Gameplay

 Lower sensitivity supported as suggested by @william

Bug fixes

 Fixed big bug when loading the game on a German desktop thanks to @NIIVAI
 Fixed the Blue Moon challenge not recording new highscores thanks to @GreezyCheese

Thanks again for helping so much on this game ! It is slowly taking shape ❤️

notes.title: 🌀 Early Access Update 0.18 : Anomaly Detected !! 🌀
notes.notes:
Gameplay:

 New level "Anomaly 1" which is a much harder version of a 3rd chapter level, available in the "Limbo" chapter
 Reworked level 1 to 8 in chapter 1, much nicer to navigate !
 Reworked the checkpoints, there are a bit more of them and nicer design
 Increased slowmo possible duration from 3 to 5s
 Perfect Bunny hop now ADDS speed !
 Nice camera effect for ending, respawn
 More appealing end level trigger


Interface:

 Upgraded end of the level UI, will go to next level automatically in 10s, and key bindings to restart or skip to next
 Better slowmo HUD
 Better options menu


Misc:

 Trees that are actually nice to look at !
 Torches in chapter 1
 Removed timer sound


Bugs:

 Fixed options didn't save correctly between sessions
 Fixed bhop preview issues
 Fixed transparency issues
 Fixed the endpanel that could be closed (Thanks to @cum machine )


🗺️ Roadmap :

 Rework levels 1-9 , 1-10 and 2-10
 More limbo levels 😈


Good luck on the anomaly ! 

(As usual reworked level's leaderboards were reset)

notes.title: Early Access Update 0.17 : Chapter 2 reworked & BHop overhaul !
notes.notes:
Hi there, another big update in the bank !  😍 

Gameplay:

 New BHop mechanic, if you hit the perfect timing you keep all of your speed, otherwise you lose 5% of your current speed
 Completely reworked Chapter 2, simplified, longer, more readable and with new assets !! And some ninja medals to unlock
 Lowered gravity a bit to get closer to that CS float feeling


HUD:

 Added blur and simplified jump HUD !


Misc:

 Added timer start sound thanks to @mz_ !
 Reworked NPCs models


Bugs:

 Fixed many levels timer start
 Fixed a speed display bug that was there for 2y !



🗺️ Roadmap :

 Rework game onboarding with easier to read first levels
 Rework chapter 1 for less jumping/climbing and way more surf !


Can't wait to have your feedback on BHop 😄

notes.title: Early Access Update 0.16 : Ramps (and all levels) overhaul !
notes.notes:
Helloooo, big update today !  😍 

Gameplay:

 New amazing materials for ALL the ramps, I think it works really well !!
 Added a surf sound when sufing and leaving the ramps (a bit repetitive for now but I really enjoy the feeling !!)
 Slowmotion can be pressed once for a 1s slowmotion (really handy for quick and difficult paths)
 Completely removed the death zones (red stuff) that instantly killed you, it just didn't work with the overall vibe of the game
 New ramp shapes
 Checkpoints doesn't require anything now, just jump on it and it saves your position AND SPEED !
 Put all jump pads on the same scale and they all give the same boost now
 All speed rings give the same boosts now


Misc:

 Changed lighting for ch2 and ch3
 The game doesn't pause anymore when opening the menu to match the "flow" vibe of the game (and it avoids some dirty tricks)


Bugs:

 Fixed speed rings sometimes not working
 Fixed collisions on launching ramps
 Removed weird death zones
 Some surfaces were hard to bhop on
 

🗺️ Roadmap :

 More surfing in chapter 1 (I only realized now that it was the core fun of the game lol)


Let me know what you think about the new surf feeling 😄

notes.title: Early Access Update 0.15 : Chapter 1 redone !
notes.notes:
Gameplay:

 Ramps dimensions redone, they are a bit longer and 1.5 times larger for easier and smoother surf
 Ramps new aspect (new material, and it changes if you are surfing on it or not)
 Smoother ramps (more polygons)
 Completely reworked all chapter 1 assets !
 Level design redone on most levels


Misc:

 New Ninja medals to unlock on all chapter 1 !! Good luck hehe
 Added wind ambiance sound
 Better names for NPCs
 Better speech frames


🗺️ Next on the roadmap:

 Finish chapter 1 in the next two weeks
 Start reworking chapter 2


Enjoy, let me know if you like the new graphics and ramps !! 😄

notes.title: Early Access Update 0.14 : SteamCloud, Better Saves & Ghosts again !
notes.notes:
Misc:

 Added SteamCloud saves
 Reworked saves in case you have multiple Steam accounts on one PC
 Ghosts are back again and can be challenged from the leaderboard !


Fixes:

 Fixed back button from leaderboard

Graphics:

🗺️ Next on the roadmap:

notes.title: Early Access Update 0.13 : New ramps, Checkpoints, UI overhaul, Tutorial rework
notes.notes:
Gameplay:
Completely new checkpoint system : you can't save anywhere anymore but you have to pray on Altars set at specific locations !
New ramps much clearer and smoother in chapter 1
Completely removed the videos from the tutorial, now NPCs are showing you how to play the game (more immersive)
Controllers are rebindable

UI: 
Completely reworked the UI to make it clearer for everyone (colorblind and low resolutions)
Added frames for NPCs speeches
New buttons
Easier to go to next level on level ending
Updated levels buttons
Added the chapter's name at the beginning of the level

Fixes:
Fixed some transparency issues on speech bubbles and environment
Fixed many UI issues

Graphics:
Started to rework many textures for a prettier game

Next on the roadmap:
Rework the timer system to make it more obvious when the timer starts
Continue working on chapter 1 with better buildings and longer levels

Enjoy !! 🙂

notes.title: Early Access Update 0.12 : Gameplay overhaul !
notes.notes:
Fixes :

 No more 60fps lock without VSYNC (Thanks to @mz_ !)
 Fixed graphic options save (Thanks to @mz_ !)
 Added support  2540x1440 (Thanks to @mz_ !)
 Fixed Infinity mode
 Build is back to 1.4Go ! I removed a lot of unused stuff


Gameplay :

 Added Ninja medals !! Unlock one by doing an incredible time on one level and you will unlock it for the rest of the levels 😃  (currently only available on level 1,2,3, 10 and infinity)
 Added climbing thanks to @Alex.Fyve, it allows to quickly climb small obstacles and feels pretty good
 Complete rework of the jumping mecanics thanks to @mz_ , dropping off a platform doesn't consume a jump now, same for going on a ramp -> you can still jump after a ramp if you have a second jump available
 Added some bhop visualization thanks to many recommandations
 Removed moving platforms from the game
 Reworked level 3 and 10
 Reworked the two markers near the crosshair to indicate the jump charges
 Secrets are a bit smaller


Next on the Roadmap :

 Gamepad playability (and Steam Deck)
 Chapter 1 overhaul (not happy with the art right now)


I would be glad to have your feedback on how the gameplay feels after that

notes.title: Early Access Update 0.11.0 : I am alive !
notes.notes:
It's been two years exactly since the last update ! This one is a small one but I'm glad I'm working on the game again and I definitely intend to give it my best to finish it ! :)

Fixes :
- Player runs quicker in slowmotion (Thanks to @mz_ !)
- Timer slows down when in slowmotion (Thanks to @mz_ !)
- Sliding off a ramp 
- Many small fixes everywhere, it's been two years 

Gameplay :
- Reworked level 1 and 2
- Added two markers near the crosshair to indicate the jump charges (will be very useful in 3rd chapter)
- Added moving secrets, they will try to escape from you !
- Added NPCs to teach you the basics of the game (I will remove videos from the tutorial in the near future) and also give you some insights about the world you are in !
- Added a len's flare that can be disabled within the options
- Reworked the particles for the first chapter
- Completly deleted the RetroControls option, I want old CS players to try the new inputs
- Added a sound for slowmotion (Thanks to @mz_ for the suggestion !)

Next on the Roadmap :
- BHop visualization to make it clearer when the player will land (Thanks to @Alex.Fyve for the suggestion !)
- Jump buffering to avoid missing BHops (Thanks to @Alex.Fyve for the suggestion !)
- Continuing reworking the first chapter

NOTE : The game size increased from 1.4GB to 3.5GB, not sure why at the moment, maybe because of the Unity upgrade, I will investigate.

notes.title: Early Access Update 0.10.0 : Steam achievements & visible ghosts
notes.notes:
Fixes :
- Fixed the timer on Edge
- Fixed the skyboxes on the chapter 2 and chapter 3

Gameplay :
- Added random ghosts in each level with actual animations ! :) They are taken randomly from the leaderboard and animated with the character skin
- Added 8 achievements ! I am open to suggestions to add new ones :D 
- Medals are now unlockable from the start, no need to finish the game once

Next on the Roadmap : 
- Add new features on Infinity mode : bhop sections, branching paths, etc
- A new hidden medal : the obsidian ! Basically the gold medal will be a good run without speedrunning techniques and the obsidian will be a really good run with speedrunning technique (or maybe just my time, so you have to beat the devs !)
- NPCs for the tutorial 

 NOTE :  The demo was removed from Steam since I didn't keep it updated since it takes too much time. It was bad press for the game since not reflecting the current quality of the build, and apparently it's generally not good for the sales to have a demo

notes.title: Early Access Update 0.9 : Speedrun mode, photo mode & animations rework
notes.notes:
Fixes :
- The camera don't clip into the walls anymore
- The slowmotion action can now be rebound
- Bindings preferences are now saved between sessions
- The "back" button now works properly in the levels panel

Character :
- Removed the head and torso of the character to avoid clipping
- Added shadows to the character model
- Set the camera a bit higher
- There is now more space between the character arms

Gameplay :
- Added the "Speedrun" mode in you finished the game ! You have a dedicated timer and leaderboard and you have to finish the game in one go, enjoy :D 
- Added a photo mode (P on the keyboard but rebindable) !

Next on the Roadmap : 
- Add new features on Infinity mode : bhop sections, branching paths, etc
- A new hidden medal : the obsidian ! Basically the gold medal will be a good run without speedrunning techniques and the obsidian will be a really good run with speedrunning technique (or maybe just my time, so you have to beat the devs !)
- NPCs, they will not be interactible but will guide you through the tutorial and some will be generated with the leaderboard ghosts !

notes.title: Early Access Update 0.8 : Infinity improvements & Bug fixes
notes.notes:
All leaderboards and ghosts have been reset with the introduction of the slowmotion. Enjoy :wink: 

Fixes :
- Timer is not slowed down anymore with slowmotion thanks to @mzvr#7919 's feedback
- Fixed the weird big turns in infinity mode as @mzvr#7919 pointed out
- Fixed the placement of the "Back" button in the leaderboards interface

Infinity :
- Medals and leaderbaords are now working on infinity mode !
- Secrets do not show up anymore in the level (UI)
- A small image above the ramp indicates the type of ramp it is to improve readability, thanks to @mzvr#7919  for the feedback
- Each difficulty step now has its own color set
- Color changes now every ramp to improve readability

Gameplay :
- New highscore is now displayed (and in color) on the end panel if you beat your PB on a level
- Timer now displays the minutes (in preparation of the speedrun mode)
- Smoothed out the slowmotion effect

Next on the Roadmap :
- Speedrun mode ! You play all of the levels with a global timer, it will have a leaderboard as well
- Rebindable slowmotion key
- Add new features on Infinity mode : bhop sections, branching paths, etc

notes.title: Early Access Update 0.3 : Chapter 2 rework
notes.notes:
Early Access Update 0.3

Small update this week, I haven't got much time to work on the game since I have a part-time job on the side that takes a bit too much time .. :sweat: 

Gameplay :
- Reworked the speed boost rings : they now work even if you are in the air and are usable only once every 6s ! It worked pretty well during my tests, I hope you'll enjoy this rework

Levels :
- Reworked level 1 & 2 from Chapter 2 (Coast) : I am going for a new graphic style on this chapter, I hope you'll like it as well ! Santorini sure was an inspiration haha
- From now on every level which will be reworked will have it's stats reset on your side (times, shards collected and leaderboard), it might be frustrating if you had good times but it's the only way to keep the game fair for everyone

Next on the Roadmap: 
- Continue rework of chapter 2 levels
- Better animations and camera
